title: Mall World Experience
content: Hey so I stumbled across this Sub by accident, it took me a while to understand. But I want to make this post because I have very specific dream locations, one of which is a mall (I always called it the name of a mall I live near), I always say "oh I had the (name of mall dream again)" So this sub is so oddly specific to this recurring dream, I thought I should make a post 😅 Even though I always said it's a dream about a mall I live near irl, it never actually*looks* like that mall, and at the same time, has a very consistent layout. Some aspects about my dream mall: (I'll genuinely have to draw a pic asp) Escalators, multiple floors Old fashioned yet modern? A giant clock hangs, outside of a section where there's more unique stores (like quirky oddity, alternative stores), the flooring in this section is decoratively cobblestone There's a giant store, somewhere in the main section that sells toys, Christmassy vibe A second dream location I always seem to have is something I call a Ghost Garden: A forest, but a house anyone can stay in, like a guest house. There's a very nostalgic vibe to it, so much that it irks me trying to link it to a place I've visited irl. Yet when I dream about it, it feels like a regular childhood location. There's also ghosts (lol as why I call it the Ghost Garden), they dance in a very specific area of the forest, almost outside the house, but not all the time Do these ring familiar to anyone else, or am I insane 🤣 They're very recurring dreams I've had on/off throughout my life it feels. Though I genuinely can't tell, they've happened so often they feel like real places
